purpose: Resolve actual service method and role at individual-service level before assigning the appropriate task course or practical qualification. No universal hazardous-execution course is defensible.

services.sourceContext: Instrument testing/calibration is a broad supplier classification; it does not identify the instrument, measurement or work environment.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify instrument type, measurement function, model and intended use of the result.
State whether work is bench calibration, installed verification, adjustment, repair or safety-function testing.
Provide the approved method, traceability basis, acceptance criteria and authority for release; identify any electrical or process interfaces.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual measurement/calibration method and any separately assigned electrical or safety-function work after those duties are confirmed.

services.sourceContext: Load testing classification does not establish the asset, test type or energy involved.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify the asset, intended test purpose and applicable technical standard or approved specification.
State whether the service includes test design, load application, instrumentation, examination or interpretation.
Provide the approved test plan, competent design/acceptance roles and interface restrictions without inferring crane operation from the label.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual test and interpretation duties using an approved safe evaluation; separately verify plant or lifting roles only if supplied.

services.sourceContext: Photogrammetry surveying does not establish aerial acquisition or a supplied aircraft operator.
vendorEvidenceRequired: State whether acquisition is ground-based, UAS, crewed aircraft or data processing only.
Identify the deliverable, accuracy/verification basis, equipment and assigned acquisition and interpretation roles.
Provide site-access and data-authority arrangements; route any confirmed aviation duty to its actual operating regime.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual acquisition or processing method; require aerial operating qualification only for an actual supplied aviation role.

services.sourceContext: Nitrogen Unit Engineering Services identifies engineering scope, not an established nitrogen operating method.
vendorEvidenceRequired: State whether duties are design/advice, equipment supply, commissioning, inerting, pressure testing or operation.
Identify equipment, nitrogen state, process interface, work location and jurisdiction.
Provide actual technical authority and method review; identify oxygen-deficiency, pressure or cryogenic interfaces only where present.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the confirmed engineering or operating duty; do not treat gas awareness as authorization to execute nitrogen operations.

services.sourceContext: BPCL E. Hiring work > Hiring Equipments: Hiring of Tank / Pipeline is supply context and does not establish included operation.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify the actual hired asset, intended use and preparation/inspection criteria.
State whether delivery, installation, connection, cleaning, maintenance, testing or operation is included or excluded.
Name the party supplying each included role and provide its specific handover and competence evidence.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess asset preparation and inspection if supplied; qualify operation, entry, testing or other execution only when expressly included.

services.sourceContext: Passenger Transport Services does not identify road, rail, marine or aviation mode.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Confirm each actual transport mode, route, vehicle/vessel/aircraft and jurisdiction.
State whether the vendor is a booking agent, carrier, vehicle-only supplier or provider of operating personnel.
Identify driver/master/pilot and passenger-assistance duties and provide mode-specific carrier and personnel evidence only for those confirmed duties.
practicalAssessmentRequired: After mode and roles are known, assess the actual transport function and verify applicable operator/carrier credentials; passenger status alone does not imply operator qualification.

services.sourceContext: BPCL inspection-services wording does not identify a technical inspection method.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify asset/material, inspection objective and method, including whether inspection is visual, dimensional or another defined technique.
State whether scope includes access, isolation, equipment operation, testing or technical interpretation.
Provide adopted acceptance criteria, method-specific qualification practice and release authority.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the confirmed inspection method and interpretation level; separately qualify access or hazardous techniques only when actually assigned.

services.sourceContext: BPCL H. Mechanical works > Installation/Maintenance of Equipment: original wording Lift work. It is not evidence of crane operation and does not conclusively establish elevator work.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Ask the service owner what Lift work denotes in this contract: asset, function and actual activity.
Confirm whether the work is installation, maintenance, repair, inspection, lifting operation or another task; do not choose one from the label.
Identify equipment, jurisdiction, included personnel and applicable technical authority before routing to crane, elevator/trade or another qualification pathway.
practicalAssessmentRequired: No universal practical qualification can be assigned until the actual lift asset and duty are identified; assess only the confirmed method and roles.

services.serviceName: Process / Utilities / Piping / HVAC Engineering Services
services.sourceContext: Process / Utilities / Piping / HVAC Engineering Services is a broad engineering parent containing alternatives.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify discipline, deliverable, jurisdiction and whether a professional approval is supplied.
Separate desk design/review from field survey, installation, commissioning, refrigerant service and process operation.
Provide actual authority, technical method and competence evidence for the selected discipline and included field work.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the confirmed engineering deliverable and any actual field technique; apply trade or refrigerant requirements only to duties that trigger them.

services.sourceContext: Non-destructive testing services includes multiple possible methods; radiography is not established by the parent label.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify NDT method, technique, material, product and interpretation level.
Provide the applicable employer written practice or adopted certification system and actual personnel evidence.
State whether radioactive sources, electrical work, entry or other access duties are actually supplied and route those separately.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual NDT method and interpretation level under the applicable practice; radiography qualification is conditional on confirmed radiographic work.

services.serviceName: Lease or Rental of Property or Building
services.sourceContext: Lease or Rental of Property or Building does not establish construction, maintenance or operational service.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify property type, location, intended occupancy/use and jurisdiction.
State whether the vendor provides only leasing or also maintenance, facilities operation, construction or emergency functions.
Provide responsibility allocation and evidence for actual included services; do not assign unrelated plant or trade credentials to a leasing-only role.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess only actual facilities or other execution duties when included; a leasing-only scope requires appropriate administrative and handover capability rather than invented trade performance.

services.sourceContext: Luboil Services is insufficient to distinguish supply, sampling, analysis, lubrication work or machinery intervention.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify the actual service: product supply, condition sampling/analysis, replenishment, flushing or another method.
State equipment, materials, access and whether machinery isolation or operation is included.
Provide manufacturer/employer method, material information and role-specific acceptance authority.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the confirmed handling, sampling, analysis or machinery method; separately qualify energy-control or operating roles only where assigned.

services.sourceContext: Pipeline Engineering Services does not itself establish construction, pigging or pipeline operating duties.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify engineering discipline, deliverable, pipeline type and jurisdiction.
Separate desk engineering, survey, construction support, inspection, commissioning and operation.
Provide the actual technical approval authority and evidence for any included field method or regulated professional duty.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual engineering deliverable and confirmed field duties; pipeline operating qualification is conditional on an actual covered operating task.

services.sourceContext: Navigation / Positioning Services does not establish marine, aviation, land-survey or desk-processing mode.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify navigation/positioning mode, platform, equipment and intended deliverable.
State whether personnel operate a vessel/aircraft, provide technical positioning support or process data only.
Provide mode-specific authority and competence evidence for supplied roles; do not infer pilot or mariner duty from a positioning label.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the confirmed positioning method and platform interfaces; operator credentials apply only where the person actually supplies that operating role.

services.sourceContext: SEQual 91111500 Domestic and Personal Assistance includes laundering context; it does not automatically establish clinical laundry or occupational blood exposure.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify whether laundry is ordinary domestic/workwear, contaminated industrial material, clinical linen or another stream.
State materials/contamination expected, actual sorting/handling/process duties and equipment supplied.
Provide the applicable employer process and exposure assessment; require bloodborne or chemical programs only where actual exposure/duty makes them applicable.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual laundering and material-handling method; clinical exposure or hazardous decontamination competence is conditional on confirmed material and duties.

services.sourceContext: Personnel / Training System Consultancy does not establish direct instruction in every technical trade.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify whether the service designs systems, audits records, develops content, delivers training or assesses practical performance.
Name the subjects, audience, delivery method and any claimed qualification outcome.
Provide subject expertise, assessment authority and validity evidence for actual deliverables; do not treat consultancy as universal operator qualification.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual consultancy, instructional or assessment method; technical practical assessment requires appropriate subject capability only for subjects actually supplied.

services.sourceContext: Heat exchanger testing services does not identify pressure, leak, performance, NDT or another test method.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify exchanger type, test objective, method, equipment and whether it is installed or removed.
State containment, energy, chemical, access and interpretation duties actually included.
Provide approved test plan, criteria and qualified technical acceptance authority.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the confirmed test method and interpretation duty with safe approved evaluation; separately qualify pressure, NDT, electrical or entry roles only where present.

services.serviceName: Material Technology / Anti-Corrosion / Surface Protection Engineering Services
services.sourceContext: Material Technology / Anti-Corrosion / Surface Protection Engineering Services contains several engineering alternatives.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify the actual material, deliverable and engineering method.
Separate desk specification/review from laboratory work, inspection, coating application and field preparation.
Provide technical approval authority and actual field/material evidence; do not infer asbestos or another specific hazardous material without evidence.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the confirmed engineering or technical method; hazardous-material and application skills remain conditional on actual included materials and work.

services.sourceContext: Permitting Services does not establish whether the vendor prepares administrative applications, supplies professional studies or issues site work permits.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify the permit type, jurisdiction, applicant and actual deliverable.
State whether duties are administrative coordination, technical study, professional certification or employer work-permit authority.
Provide the relevant authorization and subject competence; distinguish submission support from the regulator or site authority issuing approval.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual application, technical study or work-permit method; professional or operational qualification depends on the confirmed duty.

services.sourceContext: SEQual 71151502 Hydrocarbon Measurement sits under Hydrocarbon Allocation Management and Consultancy; it does not establish hands-on meter maintenance.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Identify whether the service is allocation consultancy, data review, measurement design, calibration, sampling or installed maintenance.
Name the deliverable, measurement method, equipment and any field/process duties actually included.
Provide technical authority and method-specific evidence for that scope; preserve a consultancy-only boundary where applicable.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the confirmed allocation/measurement analysis or field method; do not assign meter-maintenance or process-operation competence to consultancy-only personnel.

services.sourceContext: Navigational Services does not establish the operating mode or whether operating personnel are supplied.
vendorEvidenceRequired: Confirm land, marine, aviation or other actual mode and the service platform.
Identify advisory, positioning, data-processing and direct operating responsibilities separately.
Provide jurisdiction and mode-specific evidence for confirmed duties and preserve passenger/consultant boundaries.
practicalAssessmentRequired: Assess the actual navigation method and assigned platform role; pilot, mariner or other operator qualifications are conditional on confirmed operating duties.

boundary: Scope answers must be confirmed by the responsible service owner. Training knowledge completion never resolves an unidentified task or grants a professional/operator credential.
